content.text: The Flying Machine Boys escape a besieged Incan temple through secret tunnels, reach the _Ann_, rescue Sam, and later reunite with Havens, who repairs the aircraft and captures Redfern at a mountain fortress. Meanwhile, in Simiti, Jose, Carmen, Rosendo, and allies endure political-religious violence engineered by Wenceslas. Don Mario attacks the church; federal troops intervene, execute him, and seize Ana. Rosendo reveals he owns the lost La Libertad mine and sends Carmen with Americans through the Boque jungle, across the Tigui, to Llano, then by steamer to Cartagena and New York. Jose remains in Simiti. On arrival, Carmen is separated from Reed at the harbor, taken by a woman to a New York brothel, and begins teaching its inhabitants that God is everywhere.
